October, 2023

Author: Vivek Agarwal
Bench: Vivek Agarwal
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Wp No. 26347 of 2023
(Ramratan Tiwari And Others Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others)
Dated : 18-10-2023 Smt.Nirmala Nayak - Advocate for Petitioners.
Shri Vivek Sharma - Deputy Advocate Genral for the State.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioners are aggrieved of order dated 31.07.2023 passed by the Collector, District Umariya in Revenue Case No.14/B-121/2021-2022 on two grounds, namely, all of a sudden, alignment of the road has been changed and petitioners' land has been included in the area, which will be covered by the road and secondly, the said order was passed by the Collector, Shri Krishna Dev Tripathi on 31.7.2023 although he was transferred on 20.07.2023.
Issue notice.
Notices are waived by Shri Vivek Sharma, learned Deputy Advocate General appearing for the State.
Shri Vivek Sharma may file his reply.

Meanwhile, if so advised, the petitioners may also implead Shri Krishna Dev Tripathi as party as there are allegations of malafides against him.
Let reply be filed within four weeks.
List after four weeks.
Prayer for grant of interim relief is rejected.

However, if it is found that the private land of the petitioners was taken for the purpose of construction of the road without paying compensation then they may be entitled for payment of compensation in accordance with law.
There is incongruence in e-portal and the actual paging.

When Annexure P/13 as referred by the petitioners' counsel is tried to be opened and command is given to open page No.68 to which petitioners' counsel wishes to draw attention, typed copy of page No.52 is opened.
It shows that there is lack of continuity in the scanned file.
The Registrar (Information Technology) is directed to take action and correct the anomaly and furnish his report in regard to correction of the anomaly.

He is also directed to furnish his Ramratan Tiwari vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88903832/
1 explanation for such anomaly to the Principal Registrar (Listing), which will be placed before this Court by the Principal Registrar (Listing).

sentences.text: The case is to be taken up at 4:30 PM.

Later on at 4:50 PM on 18.10.2023 It is pointed out by learned counsel for the petitioners that the Bhumi Poojan was carried out on 5.10.2023 and since the tender process was complete, the work of road is in progress.
The issue is that how the equities i.e. between the interest of the petitioners and convenience/inconvenience caused to the people of the said village can be balanced.

The equities, to my mind, can be balanced that in case it is found that the road is being constructed on the land of the petitioners without acquiring it then the Collector, District Umariya will be required to assess valuation of the land in terms of the provisions as contained in Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and pay the amount of compensation for the same.
